system.description:
Just when a ranged attack would strike you, the striking end of your flail intercepts the strike as you try to reflect the attack back. Make a melee taijutsu attack, comparing the result to the triggering attacks result. If your attack roll is higher, the triggering creature takes your [Weapons damage] + the effect of the triggering attack.

Chain 1: The triggering creature is also pulled 10 feet closer to you.

Chain 2: If the triggering creature is within your weapons range, make your attack roll at advantage.
